variant.title: Region Sum Lines Sudoku
variant.description: Each continuous part of a line inside a 3x3 box has the same sum.
rule.region_sum_lines: All box segments on the same line have the same sum.
rule_guide.title: Region Sum Lines Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Split each line whenever it crosses into another 3x3 box. Every resulting segment on that line must have the same sum.
rule_guide.item_3: If a line leaves a box and later returns, the separate parts inside that box are counted as separate segments.
